verdict.rationale: First-party marketing confirms an in-product Sales Cloud dashboard view, "complete visibility into your pipeline," and Advanced Forecast & Pipeline Management, so in-app pipeline insight without a spreadsheet is supported. Nothing in the evidence describes a self-serve report or dashboard builder, or reporting on activity or conversion. missing for 10: documented custom report/dashboard builder, activity reporting, conversion/funnel reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
